errors.evidence: The description fails to mention the chart's title, "3个数据集平均值" (Average of 3 datasets), which specifies the chart's main purpose.

errors.text_span: 三个不同规模的图像映射文本特征网络
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states there are three networks/bars, but the chart clearly displays four horizontal bars. This error is repeated later with "图表包含三个柱状图".
The vertical axis label is "参数量(M)" (Parameter Quantity (M)), not "容量(M)" (Capacity (M)).

errors.text_span: 垂直轴值轴...具有线性刻度，从17M到25M不等，刻度间隔为1M
errors.evidence: The vertical axis is a categorical axis with four discrete labels (17, 19, 22, 25), not a continuous value axis with a linear scale and a uniform 1M interval.
This is a horizontal bar chart, so bars are arranged vertically (top-to-bottom). The term "最左边的" (leftmost) is incorrect; "最下边的" (bottom-most) would be appropriate.

The description incorrectly states that the bar's length is its vertical axis category label (17M). The length of a horizontal bar represents its value on the horizontal axis (MR(%)), which is approximately 83.1% for this bar.

errors.text_span: 该柱状图的峰值位于82%MR(%)处
errors.evidence: The bar for the category 17M has a value of approximately 83.1% on the MR(%) axis, not 82%.

errors.text_span: 中间柱状图的长度约为22M，该柱状图的峰值位于84%MR(%)处
errors.evidence: The bar for the 22M category has an MR(%) value of approximately 83.6%, not 84%. Also, calling it 'the middle bar' is ambiguous as there are two middle bars.

errors.text_span: 最右边的柱状图的长度约为25M，该柱状图的峰值位于83%MR(%)处
errors.evidence: The bar for the 25M category has an MR(%) value of approximately 83.5%, not 83%. The term 'rightmost' is also incorrect for a horizontal bar chart.
The description mentions only three bars and completely omits the bar corresponding to the 19M category on the vertical axis.
